summary_en: Capital-cost and stock-price management update. ROE and PER enhancement measures outlined. Specific targets and timelines not disclosed in excerpt.
title_en: Response toward Realizing Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: Sanko Metal Industrial filed a capital-cost and stock-price management update on 22 June 2026. The disclosure presents a multi-phase response framework addressing current capital efficiency (ROE analysis and breakdown) and market valuation (PER improvement). The filing outlines both updated measures (previously announced items being revisited) and new initiatives across ROE and PER enhancement, with a stated objective to improve PBR through dual focus on profitability and market multiple expansion. Specific numerical targets, implementation timelines, and detailed KPI definitions are not visible in the first two pages.
